name: LLF-Bench
description: We introduce a new benchmark, LLF-Bench (Learning from Language Feedback Benchmark; pronounced as "elf-bench"), to evaluate the ability of AI agents to interactively learn from natural language feedback and instructions. Learning from language feedback (LLF) is essential for people, largely because the rich information this feedback provides can help a learner avoid much of trial and error and thereby speed up the learning process. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently enabled AI agents to comprehend natural language -- and hence AI agents can potentially benefit from language feedback during learning like humans do.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark with limited adoption so far, mainly used in research on interactive learning from natural language feedback.
notes: Small benchmark and highly interactive setup; results may depend strongly on prompt design and agent policy rather than static knowledge alone.
